history.summary: CSV TOWN FLAG: the complex is actually at Morta on Meerut Road (NH 58), between Duhai and Muradnagar — not in Ghaziabad city proper. Temple complex whose foundation stone was laid on 31 January 1992 on ~1 acre (now ~3 acres); the 108-ft Shiva temple crowned with a 32-ft conch (shankh) was inaugurated by Vice President Bhairon Singh Shekhawat on 20 January 2003. Premises include Maa Vaishno Devi garbha griha, Ram Darbar, Shiv Parivar, Radha-Krishna and Navagraha shrines; the trust runs a charitable clinic, gaushala and relief work.

name: Manan Dham
town_description: Industrial city in western Uttar Pradesh, part of the National Capital Region on the Delhi–Meerut corridor; a major rail and road hub with Ghaziabad Junction, Delhi Metro Red Line and the RRTS linking it to Delhi.

travel.airport: Indira Gandhi International Airport, Delhi, ~45 km (verify)
travel.road: Meerut Road (NH 58), Morta, between Duhai and Muradnagar; on the Delhi–Meerut route

visitor_information.best_time: October–March; Janmashtami Mahotsav is a major annual event
